frequency_question: How often do major industry union coalitions actually execute an indefinite strike within the defined deadline after issuing a formal strike notice?
membership_rule: Includes industry-wide union federation strike notices in nationalized banking or public utilities with explicit deadlines; excludes localized or single-institution wildcat strikes.
window: Historical episodes spanning the last 15 years

cases.name: All India Bank Employees Association (AIBEA) Strike Notice

coverage_note: 3 named major national banking federation showdowns in the past 5 years; captures the relevant institutional bargaining dynamics.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller regional bank union actions that lack multi-union federation backing.
skeleton: Enumerate the major unified banking federation strike call cycles in the jurisdiction over the past decade, tracking whether they escalated to indefinite status versus settling or deferring via conciliation.
multiplier: 3 major escalation cycles evaluated; 1 resulted in indefinite or total disruption actions within the window, while 2 were deferred or averted via conciliation settlements.
validity_reason: Labor laws and federation structures in the banking sector remain stable over multi-year periods.
